label: Sentinel-5P co (monthly, sampled orbits) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI L2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
basis: annual mean (Jan-Dec) of the monthly values (sampled orbits; S5P starts mid-2018). Missing months are filled by the climatology-anomaly method (yearly = mean monthly climatology + mean anomaly of the observed months); a year needs >= half of the season observed unless stated otherwise.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in mmol/m2 total CO/yr. purple = decreasing, orange = increasing; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
